## What's Changed - Bump build number for TestFlight/Sparkle (marketing version unchanged) - Fix episodes being incorrectly marked played - Deduplicate queue PlaybackRecords reactively instead of only at launch/refresh - Mention playback history in unsubscribe confirmation copy - Unsubscribe now deletes PlaybackRecord history, not just episode metadata - Reorder remaining TODO items by priority - Pause playback during Siri/Maps/call interruptions - TODO tweaks - Fix 4 Swift concurrency-isolation warnings
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/geoffoliver/podstash/compare/v0.0.21-3...v0.0.21-4

## What's Changed - Bump build number for TestFlight/Sparkle (marketing version unchanged) - Fix last Queue row hidden behind the floating transport bar on macOS - Fix severe refresh slowdown and a render-loop hang
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/geoffoliver/podstash/compare/v0.0.21-2...v0.0.21-3

## What's Changed - Bump build number for TestFlight/Sparkle (marketing version unchanged) - Fix refresh CPU spike: batch the per-podcast unplayed-count fetch - updated TODO
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/geoffoliver/podstash/compare/v0.0.21-1...v0.0.21-2
